description: This file defines an interface HttpPushConfig used for configuring HTTP push connection settings, including methods to retrieve maximum queue size and proxy configuration, along with an internal enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: HttpPushConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for the HTTP push connection type, including methods to get maximum queue size and proxy configurations.

classes.name: HttpPushConfig.ConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of configuration values, each with a default value and config path, representing known configuration parameters for HttpPushConfig.

methods.name: getMaxQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of messages buffered at the publisher actor before dropping.

methods.name: getHttpProxyConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the proxy used for all outgoing HTTP requests.
